scheduleEncoding.instructionOffset: cumulative encoded width; offsets in control schedules are lowercase hexadecimal

encodingConstraints.rule: Every three-operand adds/subs Rd, Rn, #imm schedule entry uses the 16-bit three-operand immediate form and must not be canonicalized to the distinct two-operand form.
Every two-operand adds/subs Rd, #imm schedule entry uses the 16-bit two-operand immediate form.
Every function-local conditional or unconditional branch uses the recorded 16-bit .n form and exact local target.
Every direct call is the sole 32-bit instruction at its recorded offset and carries exactly one R_ARM_THM_CALL relocation to the recorded symbol; bl versus blx is normative.
Every recorded PC-relative ldr retains its exact Thumb16 immediate form and uses the word-aligned PC base at the required entry modulo-four placement; its destination remains unowned.
Every complete function body is continuously covered by Thumb code mapping beginning with $t at body offset zero and contains no interior $d mapping interval.
